gloss: behind something; in the shadows; cover

definitions.gloss: behind something; in the shadow of an object; cover
definitions.explanation: The area hidden behind an object, where one cannot easily be seen. Often used to describe hiding or observing from behind objects. Composed of 物 (thing/object) + 陰 (shadow/shade).

examples.japanese: {物陰|ものかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧。
⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{物陰|ものかげ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うかがっていた→うかがう：01273_ukagau⟧。
examples.english: A cat was watching from behind cover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{物陰|ものかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{潜|ひそ}んでいる→潜む：04381_hisomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a suspicious person lurking in the shadows.

notes:
USAGE:
{物陰|ものかげ} refers to the concealed area behind any object — a wall, a tree, a pillar, etc. It is often associated with hiding, lurking, or watching secretly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物陰|ものかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧ (hide behind something)
- {物陰|ものかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{潜|ひそ}む→潜む：04381_hisomu⟧ (lurk in the shadows)
- {物陰|ものかげ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧ (peek from behind something)
- {物陰|ものかげ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ (jump out from behind something)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧ alone means "shadow" or "shade" and is broader. ⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧ specifically means "shade of a tree." {物陰|ものかげ} implies concealment behind a physical object.
